endpoint_device_evidence.connection_policy: No endpoint is enumerated or opened. A later host may explicitly select an input only after verifying the regular Launch Control 3 Custom Mode 1 port and installed CC topology.
endpoint_device_evidence.notes: Repository topology and synthetic messages prove protocol transforms and edge behavior only. They do not prove endpoint identity, receipt, encoder mode/feel, firmware/custom-mode installation, reconnect, LEDs, or physical usefulness. The regular Launch Control 3 has no faders and none are inferred.

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC40 through CC46 press and release
gesture_state_machines.state: accepted selected page 0 through 6 plus per-button down latch
gesture_state_machines.transition: a zero-to-positive edge selects the addressed lane page at the next Core quantum; duplicate positive values and release produce no semantic event; selection never copies or changes musical records

gesture_state_machines.state: accepted selected page 0 through 7, CC47 down latch, and unsigned effect-clear generation
gesture_state_machines.transition: a zero-to-positive edge from a lane page selects Global without clearing; a zero-to-positive edge while Global is already selected increments clear generation exactly once; duplicate positive values and release do not dispatch

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC20 through CC27 while page 0 through 6 is selected
gesture_state_machines.state: selected lane's local route destination 0 through 7
gesture_state_machines.transition: route = clamp((value - 64) / 63, -1, 1), with value 64 exactly zero and endpoints exact minus one/plus one; only the selected lane record changes

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC28 through CC35 while page 0 through 6 is selected
gesture_state_machines.state: selected lane's Rate, Phase, Shape, Hits, Rotation, Probability, Repeat, or Amplitude
gesture_state_machines.transition: apply the binding-specific bounded absolute transform to only the selected lane and publish the next accepted snapshot

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC20 through CC27 while page 7 is selected
gesture_state_machines.state: Drive, Cohere, Root, Spread, Tail, Damping, Width, or Duck
gesture_state_machines.transition: apply the binding-specific bounded transform to shared effect controls only; Root is quantized to a MIDI note and every other effect value is normalized

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC28 through CC35 while page 7 is selected
gesture_state_machines.transition: CC28 updates BPM, CC29 updates Master, and CC30 through CC35 increment the ignored-global-input diagnostic without changing musical state

not_applicable_rationale: Physical mapping of lane MODEL, Note, Harmonics, Timbre, Morph, Decay, Colour, and Level remains outside revision 0.4; those accepted lane-voice values are edited in JUCE. Global CC30 through CC35 are intentionally unassigned so page eight does not reproduce lane controls.

semantic_bindings.binding: on a positive edge select complete lane/voice page CC minus 40 for CC40 through CC46; duplicates and releases do not dispatch
semantic_bindings.rejection: wrong channel, wrong CC, data outside 0 through 127, or a non-edge is ignored and counted without musical-state change

semantic_bindings.binding: on a CC47 positive edge select Global if a lane page is accepted, otherwise increment unsigned effect-clear generation once; duplicates and releases do not dispatch
semantic_bindings.rejection: wrong channel, invalid data, or a non-edge is ignored and counted; clear-generation wrap still denotes one changed generation

semantic_bindings.binding: on lane pages set only the selected lane route destination CC minus 20 using the signed absolute route transform; destination 2 is MODEL SWEEP
semantic_bindings.rejection: no valid lane page, wrong channel/CC, or invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC28 maps floor(value times 16 divided by 128) to Rate index 0 through 15
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC29 retains value 0 through 127 as Phase, representing value divided by 128 in [0,1)
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC30 maps floor(value times 8 divided by 128) to Shape index 0 through 7
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC31 maps round(value times 16 divided by 127) to Hits 0 through 16
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC32 maps floor(value times 16 divided by 128) to Rotation 0 through 15
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC33 maps value divided by 127 to Probability with exact zero and one endpoints
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC34 maps zero to free Repeat and positive values to 1 plus floor((value - 1) times 64 divided by 127), clamped 1 through 64
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on a lane page CC35 maps value divided by 127 to Amplitude with exact zero and one endpoints
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or Global context is not interpreted as lane timing

semantic_bindings.binding: on Global CC20, CC21, and CC23 through CC27 map value divided by 127 to Drive, Cohere, Spread, Tail, Damping, Width, and Duck respectively
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or a lane-page context is not interpreted as a global effect value

semantic_bindings.binding: on Global CC22 maps 24 plus round(value times 60 divided by 127) to integer Root MIDI note 24 through 84
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or a lane-page context is not interpreted as Root

semantic_bindings.binding: on Global CC28 maps 20 plus round(value times 280 divided by 127) to BPM 20 through 300
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or a lane-page context is not interpreted as BPM

semantic_bindings.binding: on Global CC29 maps value divided by 127 to Master with exact zero and one endpoints
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data or a lane-page context is not interpreted as Master

semantic_bindings.binding: on Global CC30 through CC35 produce one counted ignored-global event and change no accepted musical field
semantic_bindings.rejection: wrong channel, CC outside the declared range, or invalid data follows the ordinary rejected-message diagnostic
